answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 146638 Country: India Title: Direction of kitchen Question: I seek one guidance that is there any restriction “that kitchen (stove) should not be in Qiblah position” is there any restriction. Some here says as we should have stove opposite of Qiblah (that is our back is to Qiblah direction). Kindly advice. Answer ID: 146638 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 243/174/D=3/1438) Such guidelines are not proved from the Holy Quran, Hadith and the teachings of Shariah. It is among the common mistakes of people. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
